result_text:
I changed `exportJson` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so `all_files.zip` is built from the configured aspect names. The `reports` module compiles offline. I did not run an end-to-end export with a renamed aspect, and the module has no `DataExporter` test to run.

The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` entries are replaced by the five scope aspects, each named with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same call the loose-file writer uses, so the two always agree. The order is still main, test, generated, build and deployment, other. With the default config the entry names are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.

The `git-history.zip` write is untouched. It was never broken itself; it was skipped only because the exception from the missing `all_files` entry aborted the rest of the block. It should now be written whenever `git-history.txt` exists.

I did not commit.
